An '''[[Ewok/Legends|Ewok]] [[Scout/Legends|scout]]''' was active on the [[Endor/Legends|forest moon]] of [[Endor (planet)/Legends|Endor]] during the [[Galactic Civil War/Legends|Galactic Civil War]]. He was armed with a [[Spear/Legends|spear]].
